problem: Current O hard circle is a raw-N3 localization tolerance fitted to7 plastic external-O points in2sessions, intersected with canvas. It is not segmented physical occluder support and does not have guaranteed future coverage.

frozen_models.limits: CAL264 spans DIRECT+EXTERNAL initial-nonS compatible44, not an O-only or per-image occluder model. Max includes wood372 native/semantic tail and is not trimmed. Two incompatibleCAL frames remain in scoring. Fold heldout misses and upstream allCAL exposure remain explicit.

option_A_broader_frozen_localization_env.eligible: Same original finite in-frame nonS O predictions for which old producer emits an ellipse.
option_A_broader_frozen_localization_env.rule: center stays raw N3; radius=max(old8px floor, frozen nonSscale * existing CAL264 radius_ratio .544750754221928); intersect with same closed canvas.
option_A_broader_frozen_localization_env.missing_or_raw_outside: Preserve existing broad-canvas box. Do not introduce an outside-centered finite bound that would accidentally tighten the current broad domain.
option_A_broader_frozen_localization_env.set_relation: Each old O domain is a subset of its proposed domain; all retained O regions remain simultaneous hard localization hypotheses.
option_A_broader_frozen_localization_env.semantics: Borrowed conservative localization envelope conditional on source model/channel assumptions; not actual occluder support, calibrated O probability or future physical coverage.
option_A_broader_frozen_localization_env.tradeoff: May stop unsupported narrow-circle rejection, but often contributes little location information and cannot repair false O, native identity, missing B/I or biased likelihoods. Broader feasibility can admit worse candidates too.

option_B_soft_or_abstained_localization.rule: Separate external-O state evidence from localization availability. Keep a range membership term with zero cost inside the chosen old circle and robust penalty only for outside violation; create no O point-center residual. Or flag localization unavailable and keep only justified existing canvas condition.
option_B_soft_or_abstained_localization.hard_conditions: Actual known image/crop canvas geometry and all certified T, S/depth, retained B/I/U constraints stay explicit. A predicted O label makes in-frame membership conditional; it is not independent physical proof.
option_B_soft_or_abstained_localization.state_semantics: Do not silently relabel every O to U just because no independent occluder mask exists. Region-level abstention is an internal flag; state confidence decisions remain the separately frozen producer.
option_B_soft_or_abstained_localization.important_change: This changes an old hard localization requirement into soft/absent localization. Report O localization violation and do not claim that every original hard O circle was solved.
option_B_soft_or_abstained_localization.new_hyperparameter: Soft penalty scale/weight needs a declared source/CAL-only recipe before implementation. Do not infer Gaussian variance from empirical max7 or tune weight on TEST/R errors.
option_B_soft_or_abstained_localization.tradeoff: Avoids excluding poses solely for uncertain predicted location but may provide weak depth/correspondence information. Same-backbone BI/O correlation remains.

prohibited_shortcuts: No radius chosen from five failing frame errors, frame IDs, target crops, or oracle best poses.
No pallet-mask complement is called a physical occluder mask: it includes ordinary background.
No O or U exact corner/crossing is fabricated; no S raw/local RGB query, no new NN/training.
No partition routing, hidden dropped frames, ref-native compatibility gate at inference or old-best-pose fallback.

uniform_validation_proposal.population: All238 same records and fixed physical proposal banks, or separately declared continuous generation; CAL46 reported as calibration, TEST49+R143 reused exploratory.
uniform_validation_proposal.comparison: Frozen current semantics versus A; B only after its own fixed objective/noise recipe. Same q/Sigma/reliability/partial/geometry/Q/initialS and existing U rules; changed O domains/source binding separately audited.
uniform_validation_proposal.seal_order: Prepare source/model/input protocol, whole238 predictions, prediction seal, then reference scoring. Keep all four own-coarse fallbacks.
uniform_validation_proposal.adoption: Preserve current e default until a single uniform new method passes original49 and improves additional data under the unchanged goals. No performance promise from this proposal.
